content: Following the update strategy proposed by BIBREF11 luong2015multi, we allocate a different training ratio $\alpha _i$ for each task. When switching between tasks, we select randomly a new task $i$ with probability $\frac{\alpha _i}{\sum _{j}\alpha _{j}}$.
